ja: 彼女は今週もう3回、代わってくれたんだ。
en: She's covered for me three times this week.
alternatives: She's covered my shift three times this week.
She's subbed for me three times this week.
point: 「今週もう3回」は今週がまだ続くので現在完了で言う

ja: 僕が決められるなら、喜んで手を貸すのに。
en: If it were my call, I'd gladly help.
alternatives: If it were up to me, I'd gladly help.
If I could decide, I'd be happy to help.
point: 現実と違う仮定は if 節に were、主節に would

ja: もう一度説明してもらえますか？
en: Could you explain it again?
alternatives: Could you go over that again?
Would you explain it once more?
point: 丁寧な依頼は Could you + 動詞の原形

ja: 忙しいなら、無理しなくていいよ。
en: If you're busy, you don't have to.
alternatives: Don't feel you have to if you're busy.
You don't need to if you're busy.
point: 「しなくていい」は don't have to、mustn't は禁止になる

ja: 引っ越しの手伝い、何時に行けばいい？
en: What time should I come over?
alternatives: When should I come over?
What time should I be there?
point: 「何時に」は What time で文頭に置く

ja: こんなふうに君に頼るのは気が引けるんだ。
en: I feel bad about imposing on you like this.
alternatives: I hate imposing on you like this.
I feel bad asking you for help like this.
I don't like imposing on you like this.
point: 前置詞 about の後ろは動名詞 imposing

ja: 校正を頼まれたけど、今回はやめとくよ。
en: Asked to proofread this, but I'll pass.
alternatives: I was asked to proofread this, but I'll pass.
They asked me to proofread this, but I'll pass.
point: 頼まれた側は be asked to 〜。断りは I'll pass

ja: 君が今頼んでる人、月曜まで休みだよ。
en: The person you're asking is out till Monday.
alternatives: The person you're asking is off until Monday.
Whoever you're asking is off till Monday.
point: The person (whom) you're asking と関係詞は省ける

ja: 明日、猫にえさをあげに寄ってもらえない？
en: Could you swing by tomorrow and feed my cat?
alternatives: Can you drop by tomorrow and feed my cat?
Could you stop by tomorrow to feed my cat?
point: swing by / drop by は「ちょっと寄る」の句動詞

ja: ずっと探してるんだ。手伝ってよ！
en: I've been looking for ages. Help me out!
alternatives: I've been searching forever. Help me out!
Help me out! I've been looking for ages.
point: 「ずっと〜してる」は have been -ing。頼みは Help me out!

ja: 手伝いたいのは山々だけど、今週は手が離せなくて。
en: I'd love to help, but I'm swamped this week.
alternatives: I'd love to, but I'm tied up this week.
I wish I could help, but I'm swamped this week.
point: 「〜たいのは山々だけど」は I'd love to, but で断る

ja: ごめん、今料理中。あとで手伝うね。
en: Sorry, I'm cooking. I'll help later.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm cooking now. I'll help later.
Sorry, I'm busy cooking. I'll help later.
point: 「今〜してる」は I'm cooking と進行形にする

ja: ごめん、今夜は君の犬の散歩は無理。
en: Sorry, I can't walk your dog tonight.
alternatives: I can't walk your dog tonight, sorry.
Sorry, can't walk your dog tonight.
point: 「散歩させる」は walk を他動詞で使い walk your dog とする

ja: 駅に着いたら迎えに来てもらえる？
en: Could you pick me up when I arrive?
alternatives: Can you come get me when I arrive?
Would you pick me up once I arrive?
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形で arrive とする

ja: 窓を開けて、お願い。
en: Open the window, please.
alternatives: Please open the window.
Open the window for me, please.
point: 頼むときの命令文は please を添えると柔らかい

ja: 私が引っかかったのは、頼まれたことより彼の頼み方だった。
en: What bugged me was how he asked, not the favor.
alternatives: It was how he asked that bothered me, not the favor.
The favor didn't bug me; how he asked did.
point: 「What ～ was」で「引っかかったのは～だ」と強調する

ja: 兄は今も、あのとき手伝えばよかったと言ってる。
en: My brother still says he wishes he'd helped me.
alternatives: My brother still says he should've helped me.
Even now, my brother says he wishes he had helped.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + had + 過去分詞で言う

ja: 父より母のほうが頼みやすい。
en: Mom is easier to ask than Dad.
alternatives: It's easier to ask Mom than Dad.
Asking Mom is easier than asking Dad.
point: 「頼みやすい」は easier to ask、比べる相手は than で

ja: 昨日送ったの、もう見てくれた？
en: Have you seen what I sent yesterday?
alternatives: Have you looked at what I sent yesterday?
Have you checked what I sent yesterday?
point: 「もう」は現在完了。what 節の中は yesterday なので過去形

ja: 早く言ってくれてたら、手伝ったのに。
en: If you'd told me sooner, I'd have helped.
alternatives: If you'd let me know sooner, I'd have helped.
Had you told me sooner, I would've helped.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had 過去分詞、主節は would have 過去分詞

ja: メモ用に紙をちょっともらえる？
en: Could I get some paper for notes?
alternatives: Can I have some paper for notes?
Can I get some paper for notes?
point: paper は数えられないので a paper ではなく some paper

ja: いいよ。箱はどこに置く？
en: Sure. Where do the boxes go?
alternatives: Okay. Where should I put them?
Sure. Where do I put them?
point: 「どこに」は Where を文の先頭に置く

ja: 田中さんにもう頼んだから、君は気にしなくていいよ。
en: I've already asked Tanaka, so you're off the hook.
alternatives: I've already asked Tanaka, so don't worry about it.
I already asked Tanaka, so you're all set.
point: 頼み済みの今の状態は現在完了、be off the hook で免除

ja: 彼に頼まれたとき、きっぱり断っておけばよかった。
en: I should have turned him down flat when he asked.
alternatives: I should have said no outright when he asked me.
I should have just said no when he asked.
point: 断らなかった後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: あのとき手伝ってくれなきゃ、今も荷解き中だよ。
en: If you hadn't helped then, I'd still be unpacking.
alternatives: Without your help then, I'd still be unpacking.
If you hadn't pitched in, I'd still be unpacking boxes.
point: 過去の条件は had 過去分詞、今の結果は would be -ing

ja: 兄はピザをおごらせてから、手伝ってくれた。
en: My brother made me buy him pizza before helping.
alternatives: My brother made me buy pizza before helping me.
My brother wouldn't help until I bought him pizza.
point: 「〜させる」は make 人 + 動詞の原形（to は付けない）

ja: ごめん、今日は忙しいんだ。
en: Sorry, I'm busy today.
alternatives: I'm sorry, I'm busy today.
Sorry, I'm too busy today.
point: 断るときは Sorry のあとに be 動詞で理由を言う

ja: 貸したカメラ、まだ彼女が返してくれない。
en: She hasn't given my camera back yet.
alternatives: She still hasn't returned my camera.
She still hasn't given it back.
point: まだ返っていない今の状態は現在完了 hasn't + 過去分詞

ja: 友達に引っ越しの手伝いを頼まれた。
en: A friend asked me to help move.
alternatives: My friend asked me to help move.
A friend asked for my help moving.
point: 「人に〜するよう頼む」は ask 人 to do で表す
